If you like German food....GO!!
Dec 2018 • Solo
Ok so let's be honest, it isn't easy to find truly great German food outside of Germany. 

M.Z. is one of the only places that makes amazing (read authentic) German food in this country.

It shouldn't be a surprise, as the owner is a master butcher from Bayern. 

M.Z. also makes some amazing bread.

Their sauerkraut was some of the best I have eaten and made me contemplate buying a ticket to Germany, so I can binge on this food without annoying the owner too much!

It should go without saying that I will go back :)

The prices are very reasonable, and they have a nice seating area as well. If you are looking for a place to buy great meat-products, they also fit the bill.

Thanks again!!

A Great Find in DaNang !!!
Nov 2018 • Solo
First of all, what are the odds that I stumble-upon a certified Master Butcher from Bavaria, hand-crafting sausages in DaNang? He's the real deal and he definitely knows what he's doing. I'd been to this deli twice and it has always been a great dining experience. My first meal was a traditional Bavarian breakfast - beer, pretzel, white sausage and mustard. Beer for breakfast? Yes! Second meal was CurryWurst - french fries and sausage slobbered in home-made tomato sauce. The tomato sauce was a killer! I used it as dipping sauce for the fries. Awesome! If you are in DaNang, don't miss out on this rare find!

A taste of home far away from home
Oct 2018 • Couples
It’s now already over 2 1/2 years since I moved from Germany to Vietnam. I love to live here and I never regret it. The only thing I missed is the German food I grew up with, but I’m so happy, that I found M.Z German Delicatessen here in Danang. Michael, the owner, is a real german butcher master ( Fleischermeister ) and he truly knows his work also he does real german bread!!! He is really picky in selecting ingredients, meats and cuts for his sausages, cold cuts and bread. That’s what you can taste through his products. Also everything he makes is under German/international standards like HACCP and etc. I highly recommend this place!!! Danke dir nochmal, Michael, für die leckeren Schnitzel!!! Mach weiter so!!!!
